title: bug: prompt-cache.test.mjs, prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs and onboarding.mjs run the usage stream helper with the seat's inherited MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE, so a seat that runs them appends fixture codex/claude usage rows to its own live launch receipt: 248 fake rows in 48 live receipts across 28 tasks (10-24 to 11-03), and usage-report shows codex usage in Claude-only launches
description:
Filed by defect hunt #18 (task-1c736204, lane 2: the wrapper side of Claude account rotation and usage receipts), 2026-11-04.

PROBLEM
- Both launchers export the live receipt into the agent CLI's environment:
  - scripts/moe-agent.sh:884 and :891 `export MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE=... MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON=...`;
  - scripts/moe-agent.ps1:1251-1252 sets them as process $env.
  - So every process the seat starts inherits them, including the repo tests a worker or QA runs as verification.
- scripts/usage-receipt.mjs:71-73 createUsageReceiptWriter appends to whatever env.MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE names, under env.MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON's task, attempt and worker.
- Three test files run that writer with the inherited environment:
  - scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs:75, :86 and :95: spawnSync(process.execPath, [prompt-cache.mjs, 'codex-stream' | 'claude-stream']) with no env option.
  - scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:366-368: `env: { ...process.env, ... }`; its fake codex at :345-348 emits a 1000/900-token turn.
  - scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs:52: execFileSync(process.execPath, [cacheHelper, 'codex-stream'], ...) with no env.
- Each run appends fixture usage to the seat's real receipt. usage-report.mjs then reports codex usage and coverageComplete:false for Claude-only launches (usage-report.mjs:256-258).

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c2-receiptLeak/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs (copy it into scripts/tests/ of a `git archive 320918dc` snapshot). `env -i PATH=$PATH HOME=<tmp> node --test scripts/tests/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs` fails at HEAD, with fixture rows appended such as "codex task=task-live worker=qa-live ... input=1000 cacheRead=900" (node-test-output.txt; re-run by the hunt holder at 07:5xZ).
- Live: 48 receipt files under logs/moe-usage hold 248 fixture-signature rows charged to 28 real taskIds; 233 of those rows name a provider other than their launch's.
  - By day: 10-24 1, 10-26 30, 10-29 26, 10-30 86, 10-31 86, 11-02 12, 11-03 7. The latest is 11-03T09:04Z, launch 7657a3b4, architect-1dd28c7c.
  - live-pollution.txt has the raw lines. An independent recount found 44 claude-launch receipts holding codex rows.

FIX DIRECTION (this row: the test side, which stops every writer found)
- Every scripts/tests file that runs a usage-receipt writer must run it with MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE and MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON removed. For example, delete both from process.env at the top of the file, or build the child env without them. The three files above are the known writers.
- One guard case in scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs (CI already runs it at .github/workflows/ci.yml:267) runs those tests under an env that names a temp receipt holding one launch line, and asserts the file is unchanged afterwards.
- Error handling: the guard must fail loudly, not skip, if a child test fails.
- HELD BACK, a follow-up after the open rows on scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} land (3416b309, 62ec51f1, d861f3de): scope both variables to the wrapper's own writer commands (usage-session, usage-start, claude-stream, codex-stream) instead of exporting them to the CLI.
- Not in scope: rewriting the 48 polluted live receipts under logs/moe-usage. That is the governor's call.

FILES (4): scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs; scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs; scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs; scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs. None is held at filing (lanes.js 08:05Z). No dependsOn.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs` passes a new guard case. It runs `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` and `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs` with MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE pointing at a temp receipt that holds one launch line and MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON set, and asserts that file still holds exactly that one line. A child test failure fails the guard.

The hunt repro /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c2-receiptLeak/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs, copied into scripts/tests/ of a snapshot of the fix and run with `env -i PATH=$PATH HOME=<tmp> node --test`, passes: added is [].

`node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` and `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs` pass both with and without MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE set, and the diff touches no file under scripts/moe-agent.* or logs/.

implementationPlan.description:
TDD: write the guard first (mem:gotcha-node-test-windows-path-glob). Append ONE top-level test to scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs titled 'G1: the prompt-cache tests and the onboarding smoke never append to an inherited live usage receipt' (the gate greps '^✔ G1: '). Body:
- dir = mkdtempSync(...) with t.after(rmSync); file = path.join(dir, 'receipt.jsonl'); env = { ...process.env, MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE: file, MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON: JSON.stringify({ ...context, taskId: 'task-guard' }) }; then `delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` (node:test sets it in every file process, and a nested `node --test` that inherits it reports to the parent instead of running: local-runner.test.mjs:3700-3703 does the same).
- Launch line: spawnSync(process.execPath, [helper, 'usage-start', 'claude'], { env, encoding: 'utf8' }) exits 0; before = readFileSync(file); assert it holds exactly one line.
- Two children, each spawnSync with { cwd: the repo root (fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url))), env, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 600_000, windowsHide: true }: [process.execPath, '--test', '--test-reporter=tap', 'scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs', 'scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs'] and [process.execPath, 'scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs']. Pass repo-relative forward-slash paths, never absolute ones: node --test globs its arguments on Windows, where a backslash is a glob escape.
- Error handling, never a skip: assert.equal(child.status, 0, msg) where msg names the args, child.signal and the last 4000 chars of stdout+stderr, so a failing child, a timeout (status null) or a missing build (onboarding's 'Build moe-daemon first') fails G1 loudly. Also assert the tap run printed '# fail 0' and a '# pass N' line with N >= 1 (a run with no summary did not run), and onboarding printed a line starting 'PASS onboarding:'.
- After both children: assert.deepEqual(readFileSync(file), before), with the appended text (readFileSync(file, 'utf8').slice(before.length)) in the message.
- One comment line: G1 needs the built daemon and proxy because onboarding.mjs does; CI's build-all-platforms job builds both (ci.yml:222-231) before the step that runs this file (ci.yml:267).
Leave every existing test in the file unchanged. Then run the checkRefs command once for RED: it must fail with G1 failing on the receipt assertion (at base the two prompt-cache files append 7 fixture rows) and the hunt repro failing. Record that RED in the completion summary.
implementationPlan.note: G1 added. RED at base: G1 fails on 'receipt grew by' (codex fixture row appended), hunt repro fails (added = 4 fixture rows); pass 53 fail 2.

implementationPlan.description: Verification, once: from the task worktree run the checkRefs command exactly as written; its fresh output ending 'GATE-OK' is moe.complete_task's verification evidence. It archives HEAD into a mktemp dir, overlays the four owned files plus the hunt repro (/mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c2-receiptLeak/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs, copied into the snapshot only, never into the repo), runs npm ci + build for the daemon and proxy there, builds the VS Code bundle with moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs, and then, all under env -i with HOME a temp dir and no receipt variables: node --test on usage-receipt (G1 must print '✔ G1: '), prompt-cache, prompt-cache-launcher and the hunt repro (DoD 1-3); the plain onboarding smoke; and the bundle-mode onboarding smoke with MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE naming a one-line file that must still read exactly 'L' (the only check that reaches onboarding.mjs:52, which G1's non-bundle run never executes). Never run npm ci, a build or these tests in the shared checkout, and never in this seat's own environment without clearing both receipt variables: that is the bug (project rail; env -i in the command handles it). If onboarding fails at its second start on a loaded host, rerun once and cite both runs (mem:gotcha-onboarding-smoke-restart-health-timeout). A failure prints the failing output: fix the code, never weaken an assertion.

Adversarial self-review of this task's own diff (load the adversarial-self-review skill). Check: (a) `git diff --stat` against the base touches only the four scripts/tests files, nothing under scripts/moe-agent.* or logs/ (DoD 3); (b) each delete sits above every test() and every child process in its file; (c) G1 overrides both variables, so it can never touch the seat's real receipt, and cleans its temp dir; (d) G1 still fails loudly when a child fails, times out or onboarding finds no build. Then mutants in a snapshot (back up each file once, restore from `git show HEAD:<path>`, cmp before citing the gate): revert prompt-cache.test.mjs's delete (G1 and the hunt repro die); revert prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs's delete (G1 dies: its fake codex turn appends one row); revert onboarding.mjs's delete (G1 survives because onboarding's writer runs only in bundle mode; the gate's bundle-mode check dies: record both); drop `delete env.NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` from G1 (record what the nested run does: G1's tap-summary assertion should catch it). Put the RED from step 1 and each mutant's result in the completion summary. If any byte changed during review, re-run step 3's command before moe.complete_task.

comments.author: governor-e6142a94
comments.content:
Governor decision for the planner and QA:
1. **Historical receipts.** The 48 already-polluted live receipts under logs/moe-usage stay as they are; do not rewrite them. They are historical logs, and rewriting them loses provenance. So usage-report totals for 10-24 to 11-03 include about 248 fixture rows. This row fixes the test side only.
2. **Wrapper side.** Scoping MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE away from the agent CLI is filed separately as task-cd3887fe (BACKLOG, gated on 3416b309 and 62ec51f1). Keep this row out of scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: Running the repo's prompt-cache tests or the onboarding smoke inside a live seat, where the launcher has exported MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE and MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON, never appends a fixture usage row to that seat's receipt. Each of the three files drops both variables from its own process.env at module top, before any test or child process. A new guard G1 in usage-receipt.test.mjs proves it for the prompt-cache tests and the onboarding smoke under an inherited temp receipt, and fails loudly on any child failure. The launchers, the writer and the existing receipts under logs/moe-usage are untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: DoD 1: `node --test scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs` passes G1. G1 runs `node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` and `node scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs` with MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE naming a temp receipt that holds exactly one usage-start launch line and MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON set, and asserts that the receipt is byte-identical afterwards. Each child must exit 0 (the tap run with '# fail 0' and at least one pass, onboarding printing 'PASS onboarding:'); a child failure, timeout or missing build fails G1, never a skip.

DoD 2: the hunt repro /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c2-receiptLeak/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs, copied into scripts/tests/ of a snapshot of the fix and run under `env -i PATH=... HOME=<tmp> node --test`, passes (added is []).

DoD 3: prompt-cache.test.mjs, prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs and onboarding.mjs pass with no receipt variables (the gate's env -i runs) and with them set (G1, and the gate's bundle-mode onboarding run, whose one-line receipt still reads exactly 'L').

DoD 3: the diff touches only scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs, scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs, scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs and scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs; nothing under scripts/moe-agent.* or logs/.

RED at base: G1 fails on its receipt assertion and the hunt repro fails. Reverting prompt-cache.test.mjs's or prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs's delete makes G1 fail; reverting onboarding.mjs's delete makes the gate's bundle-mode check fail.
invariants: No file G1 runs writes to the receipt named by an inherited MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE.
The writer is unchanged: a stream the launcher pipes through prompt-cache.mjs (which sets both variables for its own helper) still appends as before.
Tests that set MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE explicitly for a child (usage-receipt.test.mjs run(), usage-launcher.test.mjs) behave as before.
G1 overrides both variables in its children's env, so it never touches the running seat's real receipt, and it removes its temp dir.
compatibility: CI's 'Test agent runtime discovery' step (ci.yml:267, ubuntu, windows and macos) now also runs G1; the same job builds the daemon and proxy first (ci.yml:222-231), which onboarding.mjs needs.
Running usage-receipt.test.mjs on a checkout without built daemon and proxy dists now fails G1 loudly with onboarding's 'Build moe-daemon first', as the DoD requires (fail, never skip).
The three edited files keep every existing test and assertion; with the receipt variables unset they behave exactly as before.
approvedScope: scripts/tests/prompt-cache.test.mjs, scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs, scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs: one comment plus `delete process.env.MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE; delete process.env.MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON;` right after the imports. No other change.
scripts/tests/usage-receipt.test.mjs: one new top-level test G1 (plus a repo-root constant if needed); every existing test unchanged.

Out of scope: scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} (task-cd3887fe scopes the variables wrapper-side), logs/moe-usage (historical receipts stay, governor decision), scripts/usage-receipt.mjs, scripts/prompt-cache.mjs, and .github/workflows/ci.yml (it already runs usage-receipt.test.mjs at :267 after building both packages).
reuse: prompt-cache-witness.test.mjs:63-66 and local-runner-bundle.test.mjs:107 already strip inherited MOE_* keys from their codex-stream children; this applies the same idea once per file, process-wide, for the two receipt keys.
local-runner.test.mjs:3700-3703's nested node --test recipe: delete NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from the child env, --test-reporter=tap, assert the '# pass' and '# fail' lines.
usage-receipt.test.mjs's existing `helper` and `context` constants, and prompt-cache.mjs usage-start for the launch line.
sourceAssumptions: scripts/usage-receipt.mjs:71-73 createUsageReceiptWriter appends to env.MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE under env.MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON's identity; scripts/prompt-cache.mjs runs it for usage-start, claude-stream and codex-stream.

Writers that inherit the seat's env: prompt-cache.test.mjs:75, :86 and :95 (spawnSync, no env option); prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:366-368 (env: { ...process.env, ... }) through its fake codex at :345-348; onboarding.mjs:52 (execFileSync, no env), which runs only in bundle mode, inside `if (bundle)` at :23-57. onboarding.mjs:65 already strips MOE_* for the daemon and proxy.

Architect dry run at HEAD 90c499e1-era tree (2026-11-04, WSL, node v24.21.0, env -i): with a one-line receipt inherited, the two prompt-cache files appended 7 rows and bundle-mode onboarding appended 1; the hunt repro failed; plain runs passed (prompt-cache files 38 tests, 36 pass, 2 skipped; onboarding printed 'PASS onboarding: ...' in about 2 s). npm ci + build of daemon and proxy took about 4 s (TypeScript 7), bundle-assets.mjs about 1 s. The checkRefs command failed at base on exactly the hunt repro (56 tests, 1 fail).
node:test sets NODE_TEST_CONTEXT in each test file process; a nested node --test that inherits it reports to its parent instead of running normally (local-runner.test.mjs:3701).
node --test globs its arguments on Windows, where a backslash is a glob escape (mem:gotcha-node-test-windows-path-glob), so G1 passes repo-relative forward-slash paths with cwd set to the repo root.
Under Node 24 the default node --test reporter prints spec lines, so a passing top-level test prints '✔ <title>' at column 0 even when piped; the gate greps '^✔ G1: '.
checkRefs: ( cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && S=$(mktemp -d) && T=scripts/tests && git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S" && cp $T/{prompt-cache,prompt-cache-launcher,usage-receipt}.test.mjs $T/onboarding.mjs /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-1c736204/A/c2-receiptLeak/hunt-a-receipt-leak.test.mjs "$S/$T/" && cd "$S" && N=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/bin:/bin && for p in daemon proxy; do (cd packages/moe-$p && env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH=$N sh -c 'npm ci --no-audit && npm run build') >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; done && C="env -i HOME=$S PATH=$N" && $C node moe-vscode/scripts/bundle-assets.mjs >/dev/null && $C node --test $T/{usage-receipt,prompt-cache,prompt-cache-launcher,hunt-a-receipt-leak}.test.mjs 2>&1 | tee o; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} = 0 ] && grep -aq '^✔ G1: ' o && $C node $T/onboarding.mjs && echo L > r && $C MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE=$S/r MOE_USAGE_CONTEXT_JSON={} node $T/onboarding.mjs moe-vscode/bundled && [ "$(cat r)" = L ] && echo GATE-OK )

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Pass a cleaned env at every spawn: rejected. That is five or more call sites across three files, and any future spawn in them would leak again; one process-level delete per file covers present and future spawns. (2) Strip every MOE_* key, as prompt-cache-witness.test.mjs does for its own children: not chosen. The row scopes the two receipt keys. MOE_TOOL_WRITES_FILE matters only for file_change or mcp_tool_call events, which none of these fixtures emit, and a broad strip could change tests that read other inherited values. (3) Fix the writer or the launchers: out of scope (governor comment-c35a995f; task-cd3887fe). (4) A committed bundle-mode onboarding guard: rejected, because it needs a built bundle (bundle-assets.mjs copies node_modules), which CI's line-267 step does not have. The gate's bundle-mode run proves onboarding.mjs:52 instead, and G1 runs onboarding as the DoD states (non-bundle), which pins that mode against future writers. Tier standard (4 steps, 4 files); a tests-only plan, so effort high.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: onboarding.mjs's only receipt writer is the bundle-mode codex-stream at :52; everything else in it already uses the MOE_*-stripped env from :65. So G1's onboarding run cannot catch an onboarding.mjs regression; only the gate's bundle-mode run does. usage-receipt.test.mjs's own writers always set MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE explicitly (a temp file or ''), so the file was never a leaker. CI runs usage-receipt.test.mjs only at ci.yml:267, in build-all-platforms after the daemon and proxy builds. The hunt repro lives outside the repo and imports ../usage-report.mjs, so it must sit in a snapshot's scripts/tests/.
planningNotes.risks: NODE_TEST_CONTEXT: without deleting it, the nested node --test misreports; G1's tap-summary assertion guards that. Windows: node --test globs its arguments, so G1 must pass repo-relative forward-slash paths with cwd = repo root. Placement: the deletes must precede every test() registration (mem:gotcha-node-test-top-level-await-ends-root-early). Onboarding smoke load flake at its second start on a busy host (mem:gotcha-onboarding-smoke-restart-health-timeout): rerun once and cite both. The worker's own seat has a live receipt: never run these tests in the seat's environment without clearing both variables (the gate's env -i does). Never copy the hunt repro into the repo tree. Project rails: no npm ci, build or tests in the shared checkout; no pattern kills.
